Want to Feel Happier? Spend $5 on Someone Else

If someone handed you $5 and told you to buy whatever would make you happiest, who would you spend it on? If you said “yourself,” well, that’s a pretty tempting answer. Your favorite coffee would surely turn your morning around; a chocolate croissant wouldn’t hurt, either.
